comparison.objective: Stretch and seat an O-ring in a hydraulic-plug groove; candidate snaps a rigid ER32 collet into a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-ring stretching, twist avoidance, and circumferential seating versus rigid-part eccentric-lip capture and tilt/roll engagement.
comparison.success_condition: O-ring seated without over-stretch or excessive roll versus collet retained around the eccentric ring after release and withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: Both involve grooves, but one tests deformable seal installation and damage history; the other tests rigid snap retention. Candidate force limits remain missing.
